description_short: An in-game to-do list: write down what is left to build, tick it off when done. Saved with your game.
description_long: To-Do List Adds a to-do list right inside the game, so you never lose track of what you were about to build. Features - Open the panel from the toolbar button, or with F8. - Type a task and press Enter to add it. - Tick a task off: it moves to a collapsible Done section instead of cluttering your list. - Reorder tasks with the up and down arrows. - Delete a task you no longer need. The window behaves like the game's own panels - Drag it by its title bar; the position is remembered. - Resize its width by dragging the right edge. - Pin it so it stays open while you work. Your list is stored in the save file, so each game keeps its own tasks. The mod can be added to or removed from an existing save at any time.
